experiments.hypothesis: High-intent online shoppers purchasing fit-sensitive electronics/furniture are willing to post a €3–€5 micro-bounty to receive verified photo/video proof of exact physical dimensions from an existing owner before purchasing.
experiments.method: Conduct 5 structured interviews with active e-commerce shoppers who recently returned an item due to physical specification mismatches, presenting the interactive FactBounty mockup.
experiments.successThreshold: >= 3/5 participants state they would have posted a €3-€5 bounty rather than making the unverified purchase and return
experiments.killThreshold: <= 1/5 participants willing to pay €3-€5, citing willingness to risk free retailer returns instead

experiments.ideaName: BatteryDuty — V2G Battery-Use Rights & Wear Clearinghouse
experiments.hypothesis: Commercial fleet operators participating in Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) grid-balancing lack contractual warranty-safe degradation clearing and demand certified cycle-wear receipts.
experiments.method: Analyze 3 public European V2G pilot trial reports (e.g. UK Electric Nation / Renault Utrecht) and interview 2 commercial EV fleet managers on battery warranty dispute risk.
experiments.successThreshold: Evidence that OEM warranty disputes regarding bidirectional cycling are a documented barrier in >= 2 fleet trials
experiments.killThreshold: OEM warranties explicitly cover unlimited bidirectional cycling with no telematics degradation logging required

experiments.hypothesis: Industrial recycled-water buyers dispute invoice settlement values due to uncalibrated real-time sensor variance against contracted water quality tiers.
experiments.method: Review public water-utility tariff dispute filings and interview 2 municipal industrial water plant engineers on billing reconciliation workflows.
experiments.successThreshold: Documented presence of contractual price-adjustment clauses tied to chemical oxygen demand (COD) or total dissolved solids (TDS)
experiments.killThreshold: Industrial reclaimed water is billed exclusively on flat volumetric rates with zero quality adjustment mechanisms
